introduction: PALawHELP offers civil legal information and links to assistance in Pennsylvania. The Legal Aid Network provides a separate application route.
description: PALawHELP offers civil legal information and links to assistance in Pennsylvania. The Legal Aid Network provides a separate application route.

sections.who: Online information is available to readers. Legal-aid programs assess financial eligibility, county coverage, issue and available resources.
sections.get: You can find self-help materials and request civil legal help. Representation requires acceptance by an actual provider.
sections.docs:
• Notices and court papers with deadlines.
  • Documents connected to the legal issue.
  • Household information requested by intake.
sections.apply:
1. Read relevant information

    Start at PALawHELP and choose your issue and location.

  2. Request help

    Use PLAN’s legal-services application or contact the provider serving your county.

  3. Explain timing

    State any hearing or response deadline during intake.
sections.after: Do not assume the website represents you. Ask whether the organization accepted your case and what you need to do meanwhile.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using PALawHELP’s operator; PLAN intake. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: It is an information and referral site.
Where does an online request go?
PLAN’s tool routes it to the program serving your county.
Can I contact a provider directly?
Yes. Use the county provider directory.
What if a court date is near?
Mention it immediately when requesting help.
